captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a short-travel trail dropper seatpost. It features a long, matte black outer tube at the bottom, an inner silver-anodized stanchion tube that telescopes out of it, and a black saddle clamp assembly mounted at the top. The inner stanchion slides prismatically inside the outer lower tube, while the saddle rail clamp at the top features a revolute articulation to adjust the saddle angle.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a trail dropper seatpost. The assembly should feature a black outer lower tube, a silver inner stanchion tube that slides prismatically inside it, and a multi-part black saddle clamp at the top with a revolute joint to adjust the saddle pitch.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject containing three main parts. First, the 'outer_tube' is built using a Cylinder primitive with a black material. Second, the 'inner_tube' is modeled as a silver Cylinder, connected to the outer tube via a prismatic joint with defined motion limits to represent the dropper travel. Finally, the 'saddle_clamp' assembly is constructed at the top of the inner tube, linked by a revolute joint around the pitch axis (Y-axis) to allow angle adjustments.
